{{Top|leg}}
'''Yohar''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. On the entry for the [[Stalker Armor M1-10]], Yohar mentioned that the extra cost for the "[[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]" configuration wasn't worth it as [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] were not much smaller than [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Near-Human]]s.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
